title: MEIKO — Street SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hi.
Is Len around?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, Akito, Toya.
Len hasn't shown up, yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You wanted to talk to him?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said he'd DJ for us here today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case he should be here any moment. Take a seat and I'll make you coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, MEIKO.
Akito, let's sit by the window.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Again?
That must be your favorite table.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It gives me the best view of the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So that's why. I like the ambiance, too.
Reminds me of Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's probably because you guys share an attachment to that place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you notice the RAD WEEKEND flyer outside?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't until now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's there as a reminder of your wish to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our feelings and ambitions manifest in a variety of ways throughout this world, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It feels so eerie, though, that a weird place like this exists, and that we can just chill here sipping coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You think it's weird?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, if this isn't weird then I don't know what is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Like, where even are we, exactly?
How come we get teleported here by playing a song on a phone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a world created by our feelings, so the song which encompasses them is our link to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know that, but that's not the point.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I don't know any more about it than you do...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I just accept that it is what it is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You just accept it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's not that I haven't wondered about it too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? Because despite always looking so serious and diligent, you've got that weird tendency to totally ignore anything that might be a pain...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
How to explain it...
To me, the inner workings of this world don't really matter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's a SEKAI created from our feelings.
I like it here. And to me, that's enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, but it keeps bugging the heck out of me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry to interrupt your lively chat.
More coffee?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, please.
Toya, aren't you into crime novels?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Isn't part of the fun of reading those trying to figure out who's got an alibi, what the murder weapon was, and the like? So why aren't you curious about this world?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In those stories, there's usually some crafty trick involved, but I don't think that's the case here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How can you be so sure?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you laughing at us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! You two are just like Rin and Len!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know if that's something to be proud about or insulted by...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't see anything wrong with it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes Rin and Len have wild fights, but they respect each other despite that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Each insists it's them that's right, so it's hard work getting them to apologize and make up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think they're only able to argue their points so passionately because they trust each.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose trust plays into this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it takes more than trust to be able to defend your opinion even if you know it will upset your friend.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Fighting with your friends doesn't feel good.
It hurts to feel misunderstood by them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I think the setting matters, too. It needs to be somewhere you feel comfortable and safe, otherwise the stress of the situation would be too much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A place like this cafe, or like Weekend Garage, gives you the reassurance you need for that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Toya.
I am happy to hear that as the owner of this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Maybe it's not just this cafe, but this entire place that offers a safe and accepting environment to us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't see why not! SEKAI exists for you to be yourselves and breathe easy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So take advantage of that and keep dropping in for my coffee!
